commits.message:
Updates
- Update Gemutlich event page
- Change coding to UNIX line endings
- Update Bob and Sally's phone number
- Tweek footer and menu

Officer page updates
- Update all email addresses to forwarding addresses at isenfir.atlantia.sca.org
- Change in office for herald.
Put the map to Cinnion and Khiba's into the proper visual framework.

Beginnings of a page for a new event.
- Add a "More information coming soon" page for the Gemutlichplatz event, so
  that it exists for fliers and the like.

Move default.css to a new directory and switch to using absolute paths for it
- Move default.css into a new css directory, so that it may be collected with
  any other CSS files which might come about in the future.
- Change all references to default.css from relative URI paths to absolute
  (rooted) paths. This will help avoid problems in the future should a file be
  moved or copied to be the basis of another file, and the need to change the
  path was forgotten.

Centralize the Google Analytics code into the footer
- Move the Google Analytics code into footer.php, so that it is included on
  all pages which use the footer already,  Placement by the footer also means
  that it is placed where the GA documentation states it should be.
Add Google Map for Cinnion and Khiba's house

Update page about subscribing to the mailing list
- Remove old mailing list information
- Add info about subscribing to the new list on scalists.org, including showing
  a sample subscription reply.

Updated officers
- Listed Elena as herald, consent recorded as a comment for date email received.
- Updated contact hour notes for myself

Complete addition of contact info for Cinnion.
- Complete adding my contact info as webminister.

Replace Kendra as the maintainer in the footer.
- Switch from showing Kendra as the maintainer of the site, to myself.

Remove hostname from the URLs
- Remove the 'http://isenfir.atlantia.sca.org/' prefix from the URLs in the
  menu, as that not needed for same-site links.  It also means that
  development can be done elsewhere and will continue to work.
